SELECT c.id, u.id AS peer_id, IFNULL(NULLIF(u.nickname, ''), u.username) AS peer_name, u.avatar AS peer_avatar, u.role AS peer_role, m.type AS last_type, m.content AS last_content, m.sender_id AS last_sender_id, m.create_time AS last_time, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `message` um WHERE um.conversation_id = c.id AND um.receiver_id = #{userId} AND um.is_read = 0) AS unread FROM `conversation` c JOIN `user` u ON u.id = IF(c.user1_id = #{userId}, c.user2_id, c.user1_id) LEFT JOIN `message` m ON m.id = c.last_message_id
mapper.select: WHERE c.user1_id = #{userId} OR c.user2_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.update_time DESC, c.id DESC
